hints.title: Last move
hints.body: A path reaches a cell either from above or from the left.

hints.title: State
hints.body: Let `dp[r][c]` be the number of paths to cell `(r, c)`.

hints.title: First row and column
hints.body: There is exactly one path along the top edge and one along the left edge.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
dp = array of ones with length columns
for row from 1 to rows-1:
    for column from 1 to columns-1:
        dp[column] += dp[column - 1]
return dp[columns - 1]
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
